Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Online Marketing & Communication Manager position at IDcreation. With a strong foundation in digital marketing, SEO, and client relationship management, I am confident that my skills and enthusiasm align well with the requirements of this role.

In my current position as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have gained hands-on experience in managing online marketing activities for clients. I am responsible for on-page SEO, keyword research, and content creation that drives organic traffic. I also build and maintain WordPress websites, ensuring they are optimized for both user experience and search engines. My work involves close collaboration with technical teams, including designers and developers, to deliver campaigns that meet client objectives. This experience has honed my ability to act as a bridge between clients and technical experts, ensuring clear communication and efficient execution.

One of my proudest achievements is my personal project, mirook.com, where I designed and built a complete website for a youth chess champion. I implemented structured data, entity optimization, and technical SEO/GEO audits to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. This project demonstrates my proactive approach and my ability to think strategically about online visibility.

I am commercially minded, client-focused, and highly organized. I enjoy managing multiple projects simultaneously and am skilled at prioritizing tasks to meet deadlines. I am also a team player who values collaboration and open communication. While my Dutch is at B1 level, I am actively taking classes to improve and am committed to becoming fluent.

I am impressed by IDcreation's focus on online marketing services and would be thrilled to contribute to your team. Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can add value to your organization.

Sincerely,

Baver Ok

## Profile
Junior digital marketer with a technical foundation in web design, SEO, and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization). At Episto, I run on-page SEO, keyword-targeted content, and full-cycle WordPress site build and maintenance for client sites. On my own project (mirook.com) I've applied structured data, entity optimization, and technical SEO/GEO audits to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. Comfortable across content management, social media coordination, and performance reporting; quick to pick up new tools and platforms, and growing into analytics, e-commerce content management, and campaign support. Based in Zwijndrecht, next to Antwerp. Works in English and Turkish; Dutch: B1, currently taking classes to improve further.
